newsitem.title: USA: J.C. Penney CEO sees Xmas sales up 5-6 pct.
newsitem.headline: J.C. Penney CEO sees Xmas sales up 5-6 pct.

text.p: J.C. Penney Co Inc vice chairman and chief executive officer James Oesterreicher said he expects 1996 Christmas holiday season sales to be up five to six percent over last year.

"We are very very positive about the Christmas. We have a nice momentum going here in the last two months. We feel pretty good about it," Oesterreicher told Reuter during a business forum being held in Fort Worth.
"Christmas gift items are doing well, furniture is doing well...and we're always a leader in men's lines," he said.

Oesterreicher said he expects the line of toys and other products linked to the "Space Jam" movie featuring basketball star Michael Jordan and Walt Disney character Bugs Bunny to sell well in the Christmas period.
"It's going to be phenomenal," he said.
He said J.C. Penney had updated its apparel lines to make them more fashionable and colorful, in order to meet a shift in consumer demand.
"We adjusted to that in the first half of the year and we are excited about the second half," he said.
